ambiguities.text: As a meta-EIP, EIP-8007 references 19 child EIPs but does not specify the exact activation order or whether they must all activate simultaneously.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all referenced EIPs activate atomically at the Glamsterdam fork block. This is the standard approach for bundled hard fork changes.

ambiguities.text: The distinction between 'Considered for Inclusion' and actual inclusion is not clearly defined in terms of implementation requirements.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Treat 'Considered for Inclusion' EIPs as mandatory for the fork unless explicitly marked as declined. Implementation must support all non-declined EIPs.

ambiguities.text: The term 'state bloat' is used without a precise definition of the threshold or metrics for measuring bloat.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Interpret state bloat as any increase in state trie size from account creation. The 25k gas charge is the quantified mitigation regardless of specific bloat metrics.

implicit_assumptions.description: The new gas prices are assumed to be economically sustainable for legitimate use cases while deterring abuse.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Legitimate applications could become economically unviable, driving users to alternative chains or layer 2 solutions.

implicit_assumptions.description: All Ethereum clients will implement the bundled gas repricing changes consistently and atomically.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent implementation could cause consensus splits or enable cross-client arbitrage attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The resource cost measurements used to determine new gas prices are accurate and represent worst-case execution scenarios.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced operations could still be exploited for DoS attacks if measurements were optimistic.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot find operation sequences that are more expensive than measured due to cache effects, parallelism impacts, or other second-order effects.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Carefully crafted transactions could cause disproportionate resource consumption despite correctly priced individual operations.
